selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: According to the passage, how does the agreement of the prophets serve as evidence about this being?
questions.answer: It supports both Allah’s oneness and the truth that this being is a real messenger.

questions.question: The passage says the earlier prophets testified to this being in two main ways. What are they?
questions.answer: They testified through their words and through their actions and miracles.

questions.question: What do the earlier prophets announce about him in their revealed books?
questions.answer: They announce his coming and give glad news about him.

questions.question: What image does the passage use to show how the prophets support his mission through their deeds?
questions.answer: It presents their deeds as if they placed their approval on his mission.

questions.question: What other kind of prophetic evidence is mentioned besides words in scripture?
questions.answer: The prophets’ actions and miracles.

questions.question: What understanding did the traveler reach after considering the prophets’ agreement?
questions.answer: He recognized that their united witness confirms this being’s truthfulness.

questions.question: What two major truths do these saints agree on?
questions.answer: They agree on Allah’s oneness and on the truthfulness and messengerhood of this being.

questions.question: What part of his message did the saints directly experience in some measure?
questions.answer: They experienced some of the unseen truths he had taught.

questions.question: How is the saints’ confirmation of unseen truths different from simple blind acceptance?
questions.answer: It is based on spiritual insight and levels of certainty, not mere unsupported belief.

questions.question: What description is given of the clarity of this proof?
questions.answer: It is described as being as plain and bright as the sun.

questions.question: What kind of proof is the prophets’ united agreement described as in the passage?
questions.answer: It is described as a strong and firm proof.

questions.question: According to the passage, what did history testify about him in relation to earlier prophets?
questions.answer: History testified that the signs and qualities proving prophethood were fully present in him.

questions.question: Which revealed writings are named as containing good news about him?
questions.answer: The Torah, the Gospels, the Psalms, and other revealed pages.

questions.question: How many examples of these scriptural announcements are said to have been set out elsewhere?
questions.answer: More than twenty strong examples.

questions.question: What is the difference between the prophets’ verbal witness and their witness by deeds?
questions.answer: One comes through spoken or written announcements, and the other through their prophetic actions and miracles.

questions.question: Who are the people mentioned in the fifth section after the prophets?
questions.answer: They are the many saints who reached truth, spiritual realization, and perfection by following his teaching.

questions.question: Why is the witness of these saints especially important in the passage’s argument?
questions.answer: Because their spiritual growth came through his guidance, so their success supports the truth of his path.

questions.question: Do the saints testify only to Allah’s unity? Explain.
questions.answer: No. They testify both to Allah’s unity and to this being’s truthfulness and messengerhood.

questions.question: What does the passage imply about the reliability of the saints’ testimony?
questions.answer: It implies that their testimony is highly reliable because it is united and based on real spiritual attainment.

questions.question: What conclusion about their master is drawn from their witness?
questions.answer: That he possessed a very high degree of truthfulness and moral straightness.

questions.question: What is the main subject of the fourth section?
questions.answer: The witness of the prophets to the truthfulness and messengerhood of this being.

questions.question: What features found in all prophets are said to be present fully in this being?
questions.answer: The sacred qualities, miracles, and prophetic duties that show a person is truly sent by Allah.

questions.question: What role do earlier scriptures play in this section?
questions.answer: They are presented as containing advance announcements of his arrival.

questions.question: How do the prophets’ miracles relate to their witness for him?
questions.answer: Their miracles, connected to their own missions, also serve as a practical confirmation of his mission.
